summary: Assess digital banking operations, payment controls, and central bank initiative readiness. Review the five-day course outline and enrol.
lede: Digital banking services and central bank initiatives involve assessing operational readiness, payment flows, and service controls. For banking, payment, and risk professionals, the course covers payment-flow mapping, exception analysis, dependency reviews, resilience controls, and digital onboarding checkpoints using ISO 20022, PFMI, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and FATF Recommendations. Participants also prepare an initiative-readiness brief and governance reports, while CBDC models and cross-border payment policy receive overview-level treatment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who operate digital banking services, manage payment flows, or assess how banking changes intersect with central bank initiatives.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of retail or wholesale banking operations, payment processing, or financial-services risk is expected. No coding is required. A laptop with access to Excel is needed for the sample-ledger exercise; no additional software installation or personal platform account is required.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
